claims.text: Loose starter mounting bolts found during PMCS are reported using Form 300 (Maintenance Report).
Loose starter mounting bolts found during PMCS must be reported within 24 hours of detection.
The specified tightening torque for starter mounting bolts is 15 ft-lbs [TM9-2320-280-20-1, C000123].
